name: Client API, Search Pillar
description:
All endpoints are secured via an OAuth token; refer to the Client API Auth Swagger for details on how to generate this token.

Versioning is achieved via the URL, and is in the format of major.minor. Specifying only the major will allow for you to automatically update to the latest non-breaking change as-and-when released, and is strongly recommended. To remain on an exact version, update the URL, e.g., /locations/v1.2/filters.
